3. INSPECT DIAGNOSIS (Check Mode)
HINT:
TOYOTA hand-held tester only:
Compared to the normal mode, the check mode has an in­
creased sensitivity to detect malfunctions.
Furthermore, the same diagnostic items which are detected in
the normal mode can also be detected in the check mode.
(a) Check the DTC.
(1) lnitiat conditions
• Battery positive voltage 11 V or more.
• Throttle valve fully closed.
• Transmission in npn or nw position.
• Air conditioning switched OFF.
(2) Turn ignition switch OFF.
(3) Prepare the TOYOTA hand-held tester.
(4) Connect the TOYOTA hand-held tester to the
DLC3 under the instrument panel lower pad.
If there is no OTC in normal mode, check the 1st trip DTC using
Continuous Test Results function (Mode 7 for SAE J1979) on
the 08DlI scan tool or TOYOTA hand-held tester.
